dct_description_sm: Contributors: United States. Federal Emergency Management Agency, cartographer

Hazus Inventory contains comprehensive inventory data with associated vulnerability attributes to estimate losses in the event of a natural hazard. The data represents the General Building Stock (GBS), includes demographic information, and data for essential facilities, transportation, and utility systems. The inventory can be used to estimate hazard exposure for buildings, population, essential facilities, transportation systems and utility systems.
